resources.string: Tap the buddy to write, fix or check.

Buddy uses Android\'s Accessibility to see where the box you are typing in is, so that the head can look at it, to read the text in that box only when you ask Buddy to fix it, and to put Buddy\'s text into it when you ask. With Fix where I type on, it also looks at what you type in a box (never a password box), only to spot @buddy; when you type it, Buddy sends only that paragraph to the AI and puts the new text in its place. It reads nothing else, and nothing is kept or sent anywhere except with your question, or the paragraph you tagged, to the AI.
